role: frozen-source-only finite FA cached-prefix coefficient output and phase reuse review

loaded_library_existing_receipt.scope: Existing proc maps prove loading, not completion or new performance acceptance.

prefix_output_conclusion.output_allocation: dq,dk,dv each empty_like(q0): [B,Hq,Smax,256] BF16; tau/center [B,Hq,Smax] FP32
prefix_output_conclusion.row_extent: row0=pi+blockIdx.x*64; every phase grid=ceil(Smax/64)*B*Hq; output storage coordinate r-pi
prefix_output_conclusion.Phase2: key-owned output r>=pi; scans later valid query c from row0. No j<pi output tile or full-history output allocation.
prefix_output_conclusion.coefficient_restriction: Tiles completely before coefficient_start or after valid return after zero writes; boundary tile may still compute and writes pre-start rows as zero. This cost is not measured as a large item.
prefix_output_conclusion.consumption: Runner passes literal pi/Li/Smax. Decoder attention_input consumes suffix dk/dv with suffix norm operands and FP32 GQA reduction. No full-history coefficient slice-discard stage.
prefix_output_conclusion.history_reads: Phase0/1 read logical keys from0 through causal suffix query; changing suffix Q changes weights/normalization even when historical K/V are fixed. Those reads are not historical coefficient production.
prefix_output_conclusion.ordinary_gradient_scope: The named P1 finite operator is not model FA backward; dk/dv names denote finite coefficients.

phase0_phase1_review.historical_register_path: Existing Qwen3 FP16/B1 register-retention schedule still separately launches phases0,1,2. Its historical predicates do not validate BF16D256 phase fusion.
phase0_phase1_review.official_FA_interface: Existing fwd/varlen_fwd/bwd/varlen_bwd/fwd_kvcache has no paired finite-logmean center interface; backward Delta=sum(dO*O) is not the general noncoincident finite center.
phase0_phase1_review.actual_dependency: Phase0 sums FP32 logarithmic-mean weights and weights*(U·V0), then stores FP32 center=numerator/denominator. Phase1 needs this completed center before its weighted-vector MMA.
phase0_phase1_review.algebra_vs_dtype: Moving center subtraction after separately accumulated vector products is an algebraic rearrangement before rounding, but current phase1 first forms lm*(U·V0-center), converts weights to BF16, and multiplies by BF16 midpoint K. Rearrangement changes intermediate rounding and is not established dtype-equivalent.
phase0_phase1_review.two_loop_fusion: Merely combining kernels while retaining both history passes would not remove the duplicated q0K0/q1K1/U·V0 products. No implemented verified one-pass owner API was found.
phase0_phase1_review.resource_evidence: Current CUDA102-103 says retaining RHS tile across score GEMMs caused register spills;140-144 already retains three owner fragments. D256 fused accumulator/live-range resource behavior has not been measured. Source does not establish impossible fusion or any speedup.
phase0_phase1_review.decision_scope: No existing verified interface can be directly configured to remove this duplicate work. No production candidate, new kernel, benchmark or numerical gate prepared.

limitations: Source-only review does not measure phase0/phase1 individual seconds or prove numerical quality.
Existing runtime 8.30s/finiteFA2.94s identifies a large aggregate, not a measured removable fraction.
No whole-DT tolerance, conservation threshold, or ordinary FA-backward substitution introduced.
